test_name: Clef style 'text renders the configured label (set 005)
description: cnb:clef-style 'text renders the configured cnb:clef-text label in the clef slot instead of the computed dozenal numeral (the score also sets cnb:clef-size-semitones, exercising the text+size path end-to-end). OBSERVABILITY NOTE: a single-text stencil harvests as one SVG <text> anchor, so its bbox is 0x0 — the label's rendered SIZE is not harvest-observable here. The semitone size math is unit-tested (test-unit.ly, cnb:clef-target-height) and its flow into the stencil is integration-tested on the dozenal style (clef-size-dozenal.json), whose two-digit display yields a size-proportional bbox width.
